blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) in Romblon will investigate reports of fish deaths along several coastal areas in Odiongan town in recent days. It was too early to link the incidents to the El Niño phenomenon, contrary to an earlier assessment by the Odiongan Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO), said Luisito Manes, acting Romblon Provincial Fishery Officer of BFAR, in a report from the Philippine Information Agency. “We cannot yet attribute the fish kill to El Niño,” Manes said, noting that the reported incidents appeared to be isolated and that the province had also […]...
